subject: [Urgent] Customer report: elevated 429s/latency during peak – possible rate/quota mismatch
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@brightlane.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-01T13:47:12Z
Subject: Spike in 429s and latency during midday burst (logs attached)

Hi Stephanie / Monica,

We're seeing a sharp spike in 429s and elevated latency for the Redwood API between 13:12–13:30 UTC today. Our ingestion pipeline hit backpressure and downstream retries ballooned.

Key symptoms:
- ~18% 429 rate on /v1/generate during the window
- Median latency climbed from ~120ms to ~1.4s
- Kortecs batch queue backed up; autoscaling didn't appear to absorb the load

I've attached a sample of our logs and a quick request dump (gateway_request_dumps.zip). Can you confirm whether anything changed on your quota/burst policy recently? This is impacting our user-facing jobs and we need a timeline for mitigation.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of SRE, BrightLane
[attachment: brightlane_error_sample.log (text)]

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@brightlane.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-01T14:02:03Z
Subject: Re: Spike in 429s and latency during midday burst (logs attached)

Sanjay — thanks for the report and the logs. Apologies for the customer impact. We're treating this as an urgent escalation.

Immediate steps we're taking now:
- Looping in infra (Karthik) to validate rate-limit/quotas and burst credit state.
- Temporarily adjusting burst-credit thresholds for BrightLane while we diagnose.
- Collecting full request traces and quota stamps from the gateway.

Karthik, can you please check whether the quota window alignment changed at ~13:00 UTC (we rolled a control-plane change overnight)? Monica, heads-up for CS + account management — BrightLane is rattled and asking for ETA.

Sanjay — we'll keep you updated every 30 minutes until stable.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Manager, Customer Escalations | Redwood Inference
[attachment: gateway_request_dumps.zip (archive)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-01T14:18:47Z
Subject: Re: Spike in 429s and latency during midday burst (logs attached)

Quick findings from the control-plane and quota service:
- We did deploy a config change to the quota-window alignment job at 02:30 UTC (rollback-safe). The change introduced an off-by-one bucket shift for a subset of service tiers.
- Gateway token-bucket still shows credits, but the quota service returned a "window mismatch" and enforced hard caps for BrightLane's customer id for a 20-minute slice. That matches the 13:12–13:32 window in the logs.
- Attached: rl_policy_snapshot.json (policy state at 14:10 UTC) with the misbound window.

Immediate mitigation performed at 14:10 UTC:
- Forced resync of quota windows for affected tenants.
- Temporarily raised burst allowance for BrightLane customer id to clear backlog.

Impact: backlog cleared by ~14:28 UTC. We'll leave the temporary burst increase in place until we finish a postmortem and a safe config rollback.

Next actions:
- Create a small rollback patch to revert the window-alignment change (ETA 4 hours).
- Add unit test + e2e check to prevent off-by-one bucket errors.
- Follow-up postmortem with timeline and customer-facing summary.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: rl_policy_snapshot.json (json)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-01T14:35:02Z
Subject: Fwd: Spike in 429s — Exec awareness / account risk

Looping in leadership for visibility. BrightLane is a mid-market customer nearing a renewal conversation; repeated incidents like this materially increase churn risk. Please escalate to the SLA & sales leads if remediation will take more than 8 hours.

Requested:
- A concise exec summary for my briefing at 16:00 PT (one-pager + timeline).
- Confirmation on whether we need to offer credits for today's outage window.

Stephanie — can you prepare the customer note once we have the postmortem outline?

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@brightlane.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-01T17:03:08Z
Subject: Update: mitigation complete and next steps (BrightLane)

Hi Sanjay — quick update now that we've stabilized traffic. Thank you again for the samples; they were helpful.

What happened (short):
- A recent control-plane change introduced an off-by-one quota-window shift for a subset of service tiers. The quota service briefly enforced hard caps for BrightLane, which produced 429s and increased client retry latencies.

What we did (timeline):
- 14:10 UTC: identified mismatch, forced quota resync, and temporarily increased burst allowance for customer id.
- 14:28 UTC: backlog drained and 429 rate returned to baseline.
- 16:45 UTC: deployed rollback patch to revert the window-alignment change.

Customer impact: ~20 minutes of elevated 429s and increased latency for some requests. We're marking this an incident and will deliver a postmortem.

Immediate next steps:
- Postmortem draft (shared privately) — ETA 48 hours.
- Permanent fix + tests to prevent future bucket misalignment — ETA 72 hours.
- Customer-facing summary and offer: propose one week of committed capacity credits and waived overage for the affected window. Monica, pls confirm commercial offer.

Attachments: logs we captured and the policy snapshot are attached for your records.

Sanjay — are you OK with the proposed customer credit? Any additional impact you saw after 14:30 UTC?

Thanks,
— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Manager, Customer Escalations | Redwood Inference
